segments.text: A university student visiting Akatsuki town when the Koushin Disaster strikes. Nao saves her and Kamori when he encounters them by chance after leaving the ruined underground passageways.
Although supremely confident in her appearance and abilities, she's really a klutz who panics easily and likes to show off her achievements to her fellow survivors, no matter how minor they might be.

After escaping Akatsuki town, she leverages her fame as a Disaster Zone Survivor by working in the entertainment industry. Her duties include filming variety shows and commercials for the local media outlets in New Akatsuki Town.

Her Baroque power is the manipulation of sound. She can manifest a parrot (which is a talking outlet of her subconscious self) and direct it at targets with considerable sonic force. She can confuse opponents by creating decoy noises and silencing her own.

The only heroine who survives all three routes relatively unscathed. She serves as Nao's love interest in the "normal" end. Despite her clumsiness and propensity to panic under pressure, she eventually matures and overcomes her opponents in the duels she is forced into on her route.
震災により崩壊した廃墟で出会う、凛とした佇まいの美少女。気位が高く皆を引っ張りたがる、クラスの人気者またはお山の大将タイプ。ただし中身はポンコツ。
基本的に意識高い系の上から目線で高飛車な言動を好むが、その実、結構な照れ屋でお人好し。いわゆるポンコツ可愛い系。そのギャップに本人が無自覚なため、周囲から愛され(いじられ)キャラにされがち。神代直のグループ内でもそういった生温かい目線での扱いが平常運転。
将来の夢は起業(業種問わず、とにかく社長と名のつくものになりたい)。ネットで知り合った友人に会うための小旅行で街を訪れたことで、震災に巻きこまれた。そのめぐり合わせから、直とは運命共同体となる。
